criteria.1: Vertical slice: summary → tool request/start → result → second summary → final answer through the real route with deterministic synthetic upstream traffic.
criteria.2: Fixture-backed coverage for the claimed runtime/path; unavailable runtimes or credentials stay explicitly unverified.
criteria.3: Parallel same-name calls, duplicate hook/envelope reports, result-before-start, late results and retries keep correct ids and terminal states.
criteria.4: UTF-8 chunk boundaries, malformed/truncated JSON, snapshots after deltas and unknown events neither duplicate prose nor leak protocol data.
criteria.5: Reasoning unavailable/withheld/disabled is an honest state, never a spinner or manufactured explanation.
criteria.6: Opaque reasoning/signature bytes survive a simulated provider continuation unchanged and stay out of SSE, previews and ordinary logs.
criteria.7: Direct, Coven-backed and SSH paths keep their authorization and environment boundaries; no provider bypass for UI parity.

statusVocabulary.covered: Route-level behavioural fixture asserts the criterion for this path.
statusVocabulary.partial: Parser/tracker-level or narrower route fixture exists; the full criterion is not asserted on this path.
statusVocabulary.none: No fixture asserts the criterion on this path.
statusVocabulary.n/a: The path is unsupported or deferred, so the criterion is not claimed.

pathStatus.passes: Every one of the seven criteria is covered by a route-level fixture with deterministic synthetic upstream traffic. Not a real-provider qualification.
pathStatus.unverified: Claimed path whose fixtures do not yet cover all seven criteria, or whose runtime/credentials are unavailable; see criteria and missing.
pathStatus.unsupported: Cave refuses or degrades this path on purpose; nothing is claimed for it.
